ask.question: How many pallets (loads) are stored per location area?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    l.ARECOD AS location_area,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.LODNUM) AS pallet_count
FROM dbo.invlod AS i
INNER JOIN dbo.locmst AS l
    ON l.WH_ID = i.WH_ID
   AND l.STOLOC = i.STOLOC
WHERE i.WH_ID = @wh_id
  AND l.WH_ID = @wh_id
GROUP BY l.ARECOD
ORDER BY l.ARECOD;

ask.question: Which parts have no footprint detail?
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP (200)
       p.PRTNUM,
       p.PRT_CLIENT_ID,
       p.DSP_PRTNUM
FROM dbo.prtmst AS p
WHERE p.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl AS fd
      WHERE fd.PRTNUM = p.PRTNUM
        AND fd.PRT_CLIENT_ID = p.PRT_CLIENT_ID
        AND fd.WH_ID = @wh_id
  )
ORDER BY p.PRTNUM, p.PRT_CLIENT_ID;

ask.question: Count open pick work per wave / pick batch
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP 200
       h.schbat AS pick_batch,
       COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT h.wrkref) AS open_pick_work_count
FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr AS h
WHERE h.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND h.pcksts IN ('R', 'W')
GROUP BY h.schbat
ORDER BY open_pick_work_count DESC, pick_batch;

ask.question: List the 20 most recent inventory movements with part, quantity and from / to location
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP 20
       d.TRNDTE AS movement_date,
       d.PRTNUM AS part,
       d.TRNQTY AS quantity,
       d.FRSTOL AS from_location,
       d.TOSTOL AS to_location
FROM dbo.dlytrn AS d
WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
  AND d.PRTNUM IS NOT NULL
  AND d.TRNQTY IS NOT NULL
  AND d.FRSTOL IS NOT NULL
  AND d.TOSTOL IS NOT NULL
  AND d.FRSTOL <> d.TOSTOL
ORDER BY d.TRNDTE DESC,
         d.DLYTRN_ID DESC;

ask.question: How many locations exist per area, and how many of them are empty?
ask.sql:
WITH occupied_locations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        i.wh_id,
        i.stoloc
    FROM dbo.invlod AS i
    WHERE i.wh_id = @wh_id
)
SELECT
    l.arecod AS area,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS location_count,
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.stoloc IS NULL THEN CAST(1 AS bigint)
            ELSE CAST(0 AS bigint)
        END) AS empty_location_count
FROM dbo.locmst AS l
LEFT JOIN occupied_locations AS o
    ON o.wh_id = l.wh_id
   AND o.stoloc = l.stoloc
WHERE l.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY l.arecod
ORDER BY l.arecod;

ask.question: Inventory quantity per part and inventory status
ask.sql:
SELECT
    d.prtnum AS part_number,
    d.prt_client_id AS part_client_id,
    d.invsts AS inventory_status,
    SUM(CAST(d.untqty AS bigint)) AS inventory_quantity
FROM dbo.invdtl AS d
JOIN dbo.invsub AS s
    ON s.subnum = d.subnum
JOIN dbo.invlod AS l
    ON l.lodnum = s.lodnum
WHERE l.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY
    d.prtnum,
    d.prt_client_id,
    d.invsts
ORDER BY
    d.prtnum,
    d.prt_client_id,
    d.invsts;

ask.question: How many pallets (loads) are stored per location area?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    lm.arecod AS location_area,
    COUNT(DISTINCT il.lodnum) AS pallet_count
FROM prodwms.invlod AS il
INNER JOIN prodwms.locmst AS lm
    ON lm.wh_id = il.wh_id
   AND lm.stoloc = il.stoloc
INNER JOIN prodwms.aremst AS am
    ON am.wh_id = lm.wh_id
   AND am.arecod = lm.arecod
WHERE il.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND lm.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND am.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY lm.arecod
ORDER BY lm.arecod;

ask.question: Top 20 parts by number of pallets in stock
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP (20)
    d.prtnum AS part_number,
    d.prt_client_id AS part_client_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.lodnum) AS pallet_count
FROM prodwms.invlod AS l
INNER JOIN prodwms.invsub AS s
    ON s.lodnum = l.lodnum
INNER JOIN prodwms.invdtl AS d
    ON d.subnum = s.subnum
WHERE l.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND d.untqty > 0
GROUP BY
    d.prtnum,
    d.prt_client_id
ORDER BY
    pallet_count DESC,
    part_number ASC,
    part_client_id ASC;

ask.question: How many unit loads are in each location zone?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    COALESCE(l.zoncod, '(no zone)') AS location_zone,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.ulid) AS unit_load_count
FROM live3.unitld AS u
INNER JOIN live3.locatn AS l
    ON l.subsit = u.subsit
   AND l.locatn = u.locatn
GROUP BY COALESCE(l.zoncod, '(no zone)')
ORDER BY location_zone;

ask.question: Top 20 items by number of unit loads in stock
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP (20)
       d.itmcls AS item_class,
       d.itmcod AS item_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.ulid) AS unit_load_count
FROM live3.unitld AS u
JOIN live3.untdtl AS d
  ON d.ulid = u.ulid
GROUP BY
       d.itmcls,
       d.itmcod
ORDER BY
       unit_load_count DESC,
       d.itmcls,
       d.itmcod;

ask.question: How many shipments are there in each shipment status?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    s.shpsts AS shipment_status,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS shipment_count
FROM dbo.shipment AS s
WHERE s.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY s.shpsts
ORDER BY s.shpsts;

ask.question: Total picked and shipped quantity per shipment status
ask.sql:
SELECT
    s.SHPSTS AS shipment_status,
    SUM(CAST(sl.PCKQTY AS bigint)) AS total_picked_quantity,
    SUM(CAST(sl.SHPQTY AS bigint)) AS total_shipped_quantity
FROM dbo.shipment AS s
JOIN dbo.shipment_line AS sl
    ON sl.SHIP_ID = s.SHIP_ID
   AND sl.WH_ID = s.WH_ID
WHERE s.WH_ID = @wh_id
GROUP BY s.SHPSTS
ORDER BY s.SHPSTS;

ask.question: How many receiving trucks are there in each receiving status?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(r.rcvtrk_stat, N''), N'(blank)') AS receiving_status,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS receiving_truck_count
FROM dbo.rcvtrk AS r
WHERE r.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(r.rcvtrk_stat, N''), N'(blank)')
ORDER BY receiving_status;

ask.question: Expected versus received quantity per receiving truck status
ask.sql:
SELECT
    t.rcvtrk_stat AS receiving_truck_status,
    SUM(CAST(l.expqty AS bigint)) AS expected_quantity,
    SUM(CAST(l.rcvqty AS bigint)) AS received_quantity
FROM dbo.rcvtrk AS t
JOIN dbo.rcvlin AS l
    ON l.wh_id = t.wh_id
   AND l.trknum = t.trknum
WHERE t.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND l.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY t.rcvtrk_stat
ORDER BY t.rcvtrk_stat;

ask.question: How many trailers are there in each trailer status?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    t.trlr_stat AS trailer_status,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS trailer_count
FROM dbo.trlr AS t
WHERE t.stoloc_wh_id = @wh_id
   OR t.yard_loc_wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY t.trlr_stat
ORDER BY t.trlr_stat;

ask.question: How many inventory counts were recorded per count type?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    h.CNTTYP AS count_type,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS inventory_count_count
FROM dbo.cnthst AS h
WHERE h.WH_ID = @wh_id
GROUP BY h.CNTTYP

ask.question: Which WCS (warehouse control system) ids are configured for the warehouse?
ask.sql:

       w.wcs_id
FROM dbo.wcsmst AS w
WHERE w.wh_id = @wh_id

convert.title: CBO_P_CLASS_INVENTORY_DE07_VIEW
convert.sql:
WITH detail_rollup AS (
    SELECT il.WH_ID,
           il.STOLOC,
           il.LODNUM,
           id.PRTNUM,
           id.PRT_CLIENT_ID,
           id.LOTNUM,
           id.INVSTS,
           id.FIFDTE,
           id.FTPCOD,
           id.SUP_LOTNUM,
           SUM(id.UNTQTY) AS UNTQTY
    FROM dbo.invlod AS il
    INNER JOIN dbo.invsub AS s
        ON s.LODNUM = il.LODNUM
    INNER JOIN dbo.invdtl AS id
        ON id.SUBNUM = s.SUBNUM
    WHERE il.WH_ID = @wh_id
    GROUP BY il.WH_ID,
             il.STOLOC,
             il.LODNUM,
             id.PRTNUM,
             id.PRT_CLIENT_ID,
             id.LOTNUM,
             id.INVSTS,
             id.FIFDTE,
             id.FTPCOD,
             id.SUP_LOTNUM
)
SELECT DISTINCT TOP 200
       d.STOLOC AS LOCATN,
       d.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
       p.PRTFAM AS ITMGRP,
       d.LODNUM AS ULID20,
       CAST(FLOOR(
           CASE
               WHEN ISNULL(ru.UNTQTY, 0) = 0
                   THEN d.UNTQTY
               ELSE CAST(d.UNTQTY AS decimal(19,3)) / ru.UNTQTY
           END
       ) AS numeric(22,0)) AS CASQTY,
       d.INVSTS AS QASTAT,
       d.FIFDTE AS FIFODT,
       d.LOTNUM AS CTLGRP,
       d.FTPCOD AS ULPALL,
       lm.ARECOD AS ZONCOD,
       GETDATE() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
                 AT TIME ZONE 'Central Europe Standard Time' AS last_update,
       CASE LEFT(lm.ARECOD, 2)
           WHEN '01' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 1')
           WHEN '02' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 2')
           WHEN '03' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 3')
           WHEN '04' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 4')
           WHEN '05' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 5')
           ELSE CONVERT(varchar(12), 'not defined')
       END AS BLDING,
       CASE
           WHEN LEFT(p.PRTFAM, 1) = 'W'
                OR p.PRTFAM = 'PAPPWP'
               THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Wipes')
           WHEN LEFT(p.PRTFAM, 1) = 'R'
               THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Rawmaterial')
           WHEN LEFT(p.PRTFAM, 1) = 'P'
               THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Packmaterial')
           ELSE CONVERT(varchar(12), 'not defined')
       END AS MATTYP,
       CASE
           WHEN pal.HGT > 1 THEN CONVERT(int, pal.HGT)
       END AS calculated_pal_height,
       ru.UOMCOD AS UOM,
       LEFT(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 4) AS VNDCOD,
       SUBSTRING(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 4000) AS VNDLOT,
       CONCAT(d.FTPCOD, d.PRTNUM) AS ULPAL_ITEM
FROM detail_rollup AS d
INNER JOIN dbo.locmst AS lm
    ON lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
   AND lm.STOLOC = d.STOLOC
INNER JOIN dbo.aremst AS a
    ON a.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
   AND a.ARECOD = lm.ARECOD
INNER JOIN dbo.prtmst AS p
    ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
   AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
   AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
           fd.UOMCOD,
           fd.UNTQTY
    FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl AS fd
    WHERE fd.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND fd.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
      AND fd.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
      AND fd.FTPCOD = d.FTPCOD
      AND fd.RCV_FLG = 1
    ORDER BY fd.UOMLVL DESC,
             fd.UOMCOD
) AS ru
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
           fd.HGT
    FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl AS fd
    WHERE fd.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND fd.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
      AND fd.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
      AND fd.FTPCOD = d.FTPCOD
      AND fd.PAL_FLG = 1
    ORDER BY fd.UOMLVL DESC,
             fd.UOMCOD
) AS pal
WHERE p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
  AND a.BLDG_ID = 'B1';

convert.title: Direct_LINE_BEVO_PRIORITIES
convert.sql:
WITH rl AS (
    SELECT
        l.LODNUM,
        l.STOLOC AS locatn,
        d.PRTNUM AS itmcod,
        d.LOTNUM AS ctlgrp,
        NULLIF(LEFT(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS vndcod,
        NULLIF(SUBSTRING(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS vndlot
    FROM dbo.invlod AS l
    JOIN dbo.invsub AS s
      ON s.LODNUM = l.LODNUM
    JOIN dbo.invdtl AS d
      ON d.SUBNUM = s.SUBNUM
    JOIN dbo.prtmst AS p
      ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = l.WH_ID
    WHERE l.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
      AND l.STOLOC NOT LIKE '%RWZ%'
      AND d.INVSTS = 'U'
),
B AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT LODNUM) AS ULIDs,
        locatn,
        itmcod,
        vndlot,
        vndcod
    FROM rl
    GROUP BY locatn, itmcod, vndlot, vndcod
),
D AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT LODNUM) AS ULIDs,
        vndcod,
        vndlot
    FROM rl
    GROUP BY vndcod, vndlot
),
A AS (
    SELECT
        h.PRDLIN AS PLNUMB,
        h.WKONUM AS PRDORD,
        h.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
        w.PRTNUM AS SPCCOD,
        w.WKOLIN AS LINSEQ,
        w.PRCLOC AS LOCATN,
        w.LOTNUM AS CTLGRP,
        NULLIF(LEFT(w.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS VNDCOD,
        NULLIF(SUBSTRING(w.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS VNDLOT,
        h.WKOSTS,
        h.SCH_BEGDTE,
        h.SCH_ENDDTE,
        w.LINQTY - w.TOT_DLVQTY AS open_qty
    FROM dbo.wkohdr AS h
    JOIN dbo.wkodtl AS w
      ON w.WKONUM = h.WKONUM
     AND w.WKOREV = h.WKOREV
     AND w.WH_ID = h.WH_ID
     AND w.CLIENT_ID = h.CLIENT_ID
    JOIN dbo.prtmst AS p
      ON p.PRTNUM = w.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = w.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = w.WH_ID
    WHERE h.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND h.WKOSTS IN ('P', 'I')
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
      AND w.PRCLOC IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    A.PLNUMB,
    A.PRDORD,
    CASE
        WHEN A.WKOSTS = 'I' AND A.open_qty > 0
        THEN A.SCH_BEGDTE
    END AS ACTDAT,
    CASE
        WHEN A.WKOSTS = 'I' AND A.open_qty > 0
        THEN A.SCH_ENDDTE
    END AS ENDDAT,
    A.ITMCOD,
    A.SPCCOD,
    A.LINSEQ,
    A.LOCATN,
    A.CTLGRP,
    A.VNDCOD,
    A.VNDLOT,
    B.ULIDs AS ULIDs_anhand_Ort,
    D.ULIDs AS ULIDs_anhand_Vendor_Lot,
    FORMAT(
        CAST(
            SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Central Europe Standard Time'
            AS datetime
        ),
        'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm'
    ) AS Last_Update
FROM A
LEFT JOIN B
  ON A.SPCCOD = B.itmcod
 AND A.LOCATN = B.locatn
 AND A.VNDLOT = B.vndlot
 AND A.VNDCOD = B.vndcod
LEFT JOIN D
  ON A.VNDCOD = D.vndcod
 AND A.VNDLOT = D.vndlot

UNION

SELECT
    NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
    NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
    FORMAT(MAX(t.trndte), 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm')
FROM dbo.dlytrn AS t;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_DELIVERY_HISTORY_FROM_DAS
convert.sql:
WITH m AS (
    SELECT
        d.TOSTOL AS LOCATN,
        d.TRNDTE AS SYSDAT,
        d.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(ds.LNGDSC, 15) AS ITMDSC,
        d.LOTNUM AS CTLGRP,
        NULLIF(LEFT(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS VNDCOD,
        NULLIF(SUBSTRING(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS VNDLOT,
        CAST(FLOOR(
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL(u.UNTQTY, 0) = 0 THEN d.TRNQTY
                ELSE CAST(d.TRNQTY AS decimal(19,3)) / u.UNTQTY
            END
        ) AS numeric(22,0)) AS TRNQTY,
        ISNULL(u.UOMCOD, p.STKUOM) AS UOM,
        CASE
            WHEN w.WKONUM LIKE '000%' AND LEN(w.WKONUM) = 12
                THEN SUBSTRING(w.WKONUM, 4, 9)
            ELSE w.WKONUM
        END AS PRDORD,
        LEFT(d.LODNUM, 20) AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn AS d
    JOIN dbo.prtmst AS p
      ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = d.WH_ID
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            pd.WKONUM
        FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr AS ph
        JOIN dbo.pckwrk_dtl AS pd
          ON pd.WRKREF = ph.WRKREF
         AND pd.WH_ID = ph.WH_ID
        WHERE ph.LODNUM = d.LODNUM
          AND ph.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND pd.WKONUM IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY pd.LAST_UPD_DT DESC
    ) AS w
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            f.UOMCOD,
            f.UNTQTY
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl AS f
        WHERE f.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
          AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
          AND f.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND f.RCV_FLG = 1
        ORDER BY f.UOMLVL
    ) AS u
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            x.LNGDSC
        FROM dbo.prtdsc AS x
        WHERE x.COLNAM = 'prtnum|prt_client_id|wh_id_tmpl'
          AND x.COLVAL IN (
              d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|' + d.WH_ID,
              d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|----'
          )
          AND x.LNGDSC IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN x.COLVAL LIKE '%|----' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
            CASE WHEN x.LOCALE_ID = 'US_ENGLISH' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
    ) AS ds
    WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND d.LODNUM IS NOT NULL
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.locmst AS lm
          JOIN dbo.loc_typ AS lt
            ON lt.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
           AND lt.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
          WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.TOSTOL
            AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
            AND lt.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
      )
      AND d.TRNDTE > DATEADD(day, -3, GETDATE())
)
SELECT TOP (200)
    LOCATN AS LINE,
    FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS DELIVERY_DATE,
    ITMCOD,
    ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
    CTLGRP,
    VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
    VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
    TRNQTY AS QTY,
    UOM AS WM_UNIT,
    PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
    ULID,
    CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM m;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_DELIVERY_HISTORY_FROM_RTCIS
convert.sql:
-- PrIME 2022 / PRIME22_DE08
-- Execute with @wh_id = 'DE08'.
WITH m AS
(
    SELECT
        d.TOSTOL AS LOCATN,
        d.TRNDTE AS SYSDAT,
        d.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(ds.LNGDSC, 15) AS ITMDSC,
        d.LOTNUM AS CTLGRP,
        NULLIF(LEFT(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS VNDCOD,
        NULLIF(SUBSTRING(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS VNDLOT,
        CAST
        (
            FLOOR
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN ISNULL(u.UNTQTY, 0) = 0
                        THEN d.TRNQTY
                    ELSE CAST(d.TRNQTY AS decimal(19,3)) / u.UNTQTY
                END
            ) AS numeric(22,0)
        ) AS TRNQTY,
        ISNULL(u.UOMCOD, p.STKUOM) AS UOM,
        CASE
            WHEN w.WKONUM LIKE '000%' AND LEN(w.WKONUM) = 12
                THEN SUBSTRING(w.WKONUM, 4, 9)
            ELSE w.WKONUM
        END AS PRDORD,
        LEFT(d.LODNUM, 20) AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn AS d
    JOIN dbo.prtmst AS p
      ON p.PRTNUM       = d.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL    = d.WH_ID
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            pd.WKONUM
        FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr AS ph
        JOIN dbo.pckwrk_dtl AS pd
          ON pd.WRKREF = ph.WRKREF
        WHERE ph.PALLET_ID = d.LODNUM
          AND ph.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND pd.WKONUM IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY pd.LAST_UPD_DT DESC
    ) AS w
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            f.UOMCOD,
            f.UNTQTY
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl AS f
        WHERE f.PRTNUM       = d.PRTNUM
          AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
          AND f.WH_ID         = d.WH_ID
          AND f.RCV_FLG       = 1
        ORDER BY f.UOMLVL
    ) AS u
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            x.LNGDSC
        FROM dbo.prtdsc AS x
        WHERE x.COLNAM = 'prtnum|prt_client_id|wh_id_tmpl'
          AND x.COLVAL IN
              (
                  d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|' + d.WH_ID,
                  d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|----'
              )
          AND x.LNGDSC IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN x.COLVAL LIKE '%|----' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
            CASE WHEN x.LOCALE_ID = 'US_ENGLISH' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
            x.LOCALE_ID
    ) AS ds
    WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND d.LODNUM IS NOT NULL
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
      AND EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.locmst AS lm
              JOIN dbo.loc_typ AS t
                ON t.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
              WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.TOSTOL
                AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
                AND t.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
          )
      AND d.TRNDTE >= DATEADD(minute, -120, GETDATE())
      AND d.TRNDTE <= GETDATE()
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    LOCATN AS LINE,
    FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS DELIVERY_DATE,
    ITMCOD,
    ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
    CTLGRP,
    VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
    VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
    TRNQTY AS QTY,
    UOM AS WM_UNIT,
    PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
    ULID,
    CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM m;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURN_HISTORY_FROM_DAS
convert.sql:
WITH m AS (
    SELECT d.FRSTOL AS LOCATN,
           d.TRNDTE AS SYSDAT,
           d.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
           LEFT(ds.LNGDSC, 15) AS ITMDSC,
           d.LOTNUM AS CTLGRP,
           NULLIF(LEFT(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS VNDCOD,
           NULLIF(SUBSTRING(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS VNDLOT,
           CAST(FLOOR(
               CASE
                   WHEN ISNULL(u.UNTQTY, 0) = 0 THEN d.TRNQTY
                   ELSE CAST(d.TRNQTY AS decimal(19,3)) / u.UNTQTY
               END
           ) AS numeric(22,0)) AS TRNQTY,
           ISNULL(u.UOMCOD, p.STKUOM) AS UOM,
           CASE
               WHEN w.WKONUM LIKE '000%' AND LEN(w.WKONUM) = 12
                   THEN SUBSTRING(w.WKONUM, 4, 9)
               ELSE w.WKONUM
           END AS PRDORD,
           d.LODNUM AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN dbo.prtmst p
      ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = d.WH_ID
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 pd.WKONUM
        FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr ph
        JOIN dbo.pckwrk_dtl pd
          ON pd.WRKREF = ph.WRKREF
         AND pd.WH_ID = ph.WH_ID
        WHERE ph.PALLET_ID = d.LODNUM
          AND ph.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND pd.WKONUM IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY pd.LAST_UPD_DT DESC
    ) w
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 f.UOMCOD,
                     f.UNTQTY
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl f
        WHERE f.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
          AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
          AND f.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND f.RCV_FLG = 1
        ORDER BY f.UOMLVL
    ) u
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 x.LNGDSC
        FROM dbo.prtdsc x
        WHERE x.COLNAM = 'prtnum|prt_client_id|wh_id_tmpl'
          AND x.COLVAL IN (
              d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|' + d.WH_ID,
              d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|----'
          )
          AND x.LNGDSC IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN x.COLVAL LIKE '%|----' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
                 CASE WHEN x.LOCALE_ID = 'US_ENGLISH' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
    ) ds
    WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND d.LODNUM IS NOT NULL
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.locmst lm
          JOIN dbo.loc_typ t
            ON t.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
           AND t.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
          WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.FRSTOL
            AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
            AND t.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.locmst lm
          JOIN dbo.loc_typ t
            ON t.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
           AND t.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
          WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.TOSTOL
            AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
            AND t.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
      )
      AND d.TRNDTE > DATEADD(day, -3, GETDATE())
)
SELECT TOP 200
       CASE LOCATN
           WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4'
           WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3'
           ELSE LOCATN
       END AS LINE,
       FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS RETURN_DATE,
       ITMCOD,
       ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
       CTLGRP,
       VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
       VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
       TRNQTY AS QTY,
       UOM AS WM_UNIT,
       PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
       ULID,
       CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM m
ORDER BY SYSDAT DESC;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURN_HISTORY_FROM_RTCIS
convert.sql:
WITH m AS (
    SELECT TOP 200
           d.FRSTOL AS LOCATN,
           d.TRNDTE AS SYSDAT,
           d.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
           LEFT(ds.LNGDSC, 15) AS ITMDSC,
           d.LOTNUM AS CTLGRP,
           NULLIF(LEFT(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS VNDCOD,
           NULLIF(SUBSTRING(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS VNDLOT,
           CAST(FLOOR(
               CASE
                   WHEN ISNULL(u.UNTQTY, 0) = 0 THEN d.TRNQTY
                   ELSE CAST(d.TRNQTY AS decimal(19,3)) / u.UNTQTY
               END
           ) AS numeric(22,0)) AS TRNQTY,
           ISNULL(u.UOMCOD, p.STKUOM) AS UOM,
           CASE
               WHEN w.WKONUM LIKE '000%' AND LEN(w.WKONUM) = 12
                   THEN SUBSTRING(w.WKONUM, 4, 9)
               ELSE w.WKONUM
           END AS PRDORD,
           d.LODNUM AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN dbo.prtmst p
      ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 pd.WKONUM
        FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr ph
        JOIN dbo.pckwrk_dtl pd
          ON pd.WRKREF = ph.WRKREF
         AND pd.WH_ID = ph.WH_ID
        WHERE ph.LODNUM = d.LODNUM
          AND ph.WH_ID = @wh_id
          AND pd.WKONUM IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY pd.LAST_UPD_DT DESC
    ) w
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
               f.UOMCOD,
               f.UNTQTY
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl f
        WHERE f.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
          AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
          AND f.WH_ID = @wh_id
          AND f.RCV_FLG = 1
        ORDER BY f.UOMLVL
    ) u
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 x.LNGDSC
        FROM dbo.prtdsc x
        WHERE x.COLNAM = 'prtnum|prt_client_id|wh_id_tmpl'
          AND x.COLVAL IN (
              d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|' + @wh_id,
              d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|----'
          )
          AND x.LNGDSC IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN x.COLVAL LIKE '%|----' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
            CASE WHEN x.LOCALE_ID = 'US_ENGLISH' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
    ) ds
    WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND d.LODNUM IS NOT NULL
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
      -- RTCIS MANLID at ULIN% is represented as a ROH pallet leaving production.
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.prod_line pl
          WHERE pl.WH_ID = @wh_id
            AND pl.STOLOC = d.FRSTOL
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.prod_line pl
          WHERE pl.WH_ID = @wh_id
            AND pl.STOLOC = d.TOSTOL
      )
      AND d.TRNDTE > DATEADD(day, -33, GETDATE())
      AND d.TRNDTE <= GETDATE()
    ORDER BY d.TRNDTE DESC
)
SELECT LOCATN AS LINE,
       FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS RETURN_DATE,
       ITMCOD,
       ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
       CTLGRP,
       VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
       VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
       TRNQTY AS QTY,
       UOM AS WM_UNIT,
       PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
       ULID,
       CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM m
ORDER BY SYSDAT DESC;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURNS_90days_wholeQtyBack
convert.sql:
WITH moves AS (
    SELECT
        d.TRNDTE,
        d.PRTNUM,
        d.PRT_CLIENT_ID,
        d.LODNUM,
        d.FRSTOL,
        d.TOSTOL,
        CAST(FLOOR(
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL(u.UNTQTY, 0) = 0 THEN d.TRNQTY
                ELSE CAST(d.TRNQTY AS decimal(19,3)) / u.UNTQTY
            END
        ) AS numeric(22,0)) AS QTY,
        ISNULL(u.UOMCOD, p.STKUOM) AS WHSE_UNIT,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.locmst lm
            JOIN dbo.loc_typ lt
              ON lt.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
             AND lt.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
            WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.TOSTOL
              AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
              AND lt.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS to_line,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.locmst lm
            JOIN dbo.loc_typ lt
              ON lt.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
             AND lt.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
            WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.FRSTOL
              AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
              AND lt.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS from_line
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN dbo.prtmst p
      ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = d.WH_ID
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            f.UOMCOD,
            f.UNTQTY
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl f
        WHERE f.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
          AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
          AND f.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND f.RCV_FLG = 1
        ORDER BY f.UOMLVL
    ) u
    WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND d.LODNUM IS NOT NULL
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
),
RankedDeliveries AS (
    SELECT
        m.TRNDTE AS DELIVERY_DATE,
        m.TOSTOL AS LINE,
        CASE
            WHEN w.WKONUM LIKE '000%' AND LEN(w.WKONUM) = 12
                THEN SUBSTRING(w.WKONUM, 4, 9)
            ELSE w.WKONUM
        END AS PROCESS_ORDER,
        m.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
        p.PRTFAM AS ITMGRP,
        g.LNGDSC AS grpdsc,
        m.QTY,
        m.WHSE_UNIT,
        m.LODNUM AS ULID,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.LODNUM
            ORDER BY m.TRNDTE ASC
        ) AS DeliveryRank
    FROM moves m
    JOIN dbo.prtmst p
      ON p.PRTNUM = m.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = m.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            dm.LNGDSC
        FROM dbo.dscmst dm
        WHERE dm.COLNAM = 'prtfam'
          AND dm.COLVAL = p.PRTFAM
          AND dm.LNGDSC IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN dm.LOCALE_ID = 'US_ENGLISH' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
            dm.LOCALE_ID
    ) g
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            pd.WKONUM
        FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr ph
        JOIN dbo.pckwrk_dtl pd
          ON pd.WRKREF = ph.WRKREF
         AND pd.WH_ID = ph.WH_ID
        WHERE ph.LODNUM = m.LODNUM
          AND ph.WH_ID = @wh_id
          AND pd.WKONUM IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY pd.LAST_UPD_DT DESC
    ) w
    WHERE m.to_line = 1
      AND m.from_line = 0
      AND m.TRNDTE > CAST(GETDATE() - 90 AS date)
      AND m.TRNDTE < CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
      -- RTCIS ULINA*/ULINC* staging equivalents [INFERRED, site-specific].
      AND m.TOSTOL NOT LIKE 'SLA%'
      AND m.TOSTOL NOT LIKE 'SLC%'
),
RankedReturns AS (
    SELECT
        m.LODNUM AS ULID,
        m.TRNDTE AS RETURN_DATE,
        m.QTY,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.LODNUM
            ORDER BY m.TRNDTE ASC
        ) AS ReturnRank
    FROM moves m
    WHERE m.from_line = 1
      AND m.to_line = 0
)
SELECT
    d.DELIVERY_DATE,
    d.LINE,
    d.PROCESS_ORDER,
    d.ITMCOD,
    d.ITMGRP,
    d.grpdsc,
    d.QTY,
    d.WHSE_UNIT,
    d.ULID,
    r.RETURN_DATE,
    r.QTY AS RETURN_QTY,
    DATEDIFF(MINUTE, d.DELIVERY_DATE, r.RETURN_DATE) AS DATE_DIFF
FROM RankedDeliveries d
JOIN RankedReturns r
  ON r.ULID = d.ULID
 AND r.ReturnRank = d.DeliveryRank
WHERE d.DELIVERY_DATE < r.RETURN_DATE
  AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, d.DELIVERY_DATE, r.RETURN_DATE) < 960
  AND d.QTY = r.QTY
ORDER BY d.ULID, d.DELIVERY_DATE ASC;
